correctness.rationale: The eight-site centrally punctured 3x3 support and three-root gauge yield exactly q^5 normalized arrays for each q=2,...,8. All 12 aperiodic half-plane displacements are exhaustively scored. Inspected check_psl.py represents q=5,7,8 squared magnitudes in exact quadratic/cubic rings and distinguishes q=7 values by a rational isolating interval, not by rounded floating-point ties. Independent reimplementation enumerated all 61,775 normalized assignments and reproduced every minimum and optimizer count: 4/20, 3/8, 2/24, (3+sqrt(5))/2 /240, 1/2, 4cos²(2pi/7)/28, and 2/114. The corner displacement (2,2) forces PSL>=1 for every phase; exhibited q=6 vector attains it. This proves exactly q<=8, not all alphabets.
residual_risks: Independent bounded numerical tests corroborate but do not replace the analytic/finite-exhaustive proof as detailed.
